title: Sofra — chat stream event (one NDJSON line)
description: POST /api/chat responds with application/x-ndjson: one JSON object per line. Applying the events in seq order yields a document that must validate against ui_spec.schema.json. The transport gives no guarantees beyond TCP: network chunks do not align with lines or with UTF-8 characters, events can be delivered more than once, and a stream can end without a `done` event.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per stream. An event whose seq has already been applied is a duplicate and must be ignored.

version.description: ui_spec version of this response. The client supports "1" only.

conversation_id.description: Send it back on the next turn to continue the conversation.

server_now.description: ISO-8601. The server's clock. It is NOT the browser's clock.

oneOf.description: A complete block at position `index` of the final `blocks` array. Text blocks arrive with markdown "" and are filled by subsequent text_delta events.

block.description: Validate against ui_spec.schema.json#/definitions/block. May be invalid or of an unknown type.

oneOf.description: Append `delta` to the markdown of the text block at `index`. Deltas split text at arbitrary points, including inside markdown syntax.
The audit record. Arrives after the last block.
The response is complete. A stream that closes without `done` is incomplete, whatever it has delivered.
The server gave up on this response. Nothing after it will arrive.
